#!/usr/bin/env bash
# R1264w/x: ordinary arithmetic, here-strings and heredocs, with no shadowing definition: nothing refused.
(( m <<= s ))
cat <<<"x y"
read -r v <<<"$v"
let "v = 1 << n"
echo "$(( 1 << 3 ))"
cat <<'EOF2'
test() { a body in a heredoc is text }
EOF2
echo $(x)#'not a comment'
case "$f" in
  *.sh) echo sh ;;
esac
name="$(case "$f" in *.json) sed 's/"//g' "$f" ;; esac)"
